So we need to round the result of liter_to_gallon to two decimals. Then pass that to fillFuelTank.

3. estimate_distance with those zipcodes
4. liter_to_gallon with liter=40 -> gallons
5. round gallons to two decimals
6. fillFuelTank with fuelAmount = rounded gallons

We need to call functions sequentially. We'll do calls in order.
